About Mokoto – Glitch Typeface Font

Mokoto – Glitch Typeface Font

Introducing a new layered multiply typeface called Mokoto – Glitch Typeface Font! Mokoto is an experimental font that gives the appearance of digital glitching effect! Inspired from modern fonts and slicing image in error system, to create something different and compelling.

This font makes way for the creativity of each and every one. You can easily add your text using the font layer. Mokoto contains 4 font layer (Regular, Glitch Mark I, Glitch Mark II, and Glitch Outline Regular).

You can customize the layer to your need. Modify, give it colors and blending to instantly give futuristic feel and glitch effects. Mokoto is the ideal display or lead font for designs web, print projects, contemporary posters, forward looking motion graphics, video game, cover CD Album, and other items like logos, poster/ flyer, branding, packaging, pictograms, etc.

Mokoto – Glitch Typeface Font features:

  • Character Set (Uppercase & Lowercase)
  • Number & Punctuation
  • Multilingual
  • Multiply Effect
  • Layered Font: Regular, Glitch Mark I, Glitch Mark II, and Glitch Outline Regular

File Included: OTF & TTF

Do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions about this product. Hope you likeand enjoy it 🙂

Elevate and explore the design possibilities with this Futuristic Font! Check out our other fonts!

Don’t forget to follow our Instagram @drizy_font

We also cater to custom license requests and specific business needs.

Trial

If you’re seeking the ability to test out different font variations in your layout, present them to clients, and choose the most suitable one for your project, our trial option is for you.
 
This specific license is created specifically for sharing information and is not meant to be used for commercial purposes.

Desktop

This license is suitable for purposes including logo design, digital images on websites or social media, as well as in print media, souvenirs, and merchandise for sale.

*You can obtain a Desktop License in the Freelance or Commercial package, depending on the number of users/devices, company scale, and the quantity needed for products, print, sales, impressions, page views, and images.

Webfont

If you’re looking to use the font for headings or text blocks on your website, this commercial font license is the right choice.

*You can obtain a Webfont License in the Freelance or Commercial package, depending on the number of users/devices, company scale, and the quantity needed for products, print, sales, impressions, page views, and images.

App

If you’re creating applications for Windows, Android, iOS, Linux, or other operating systems, this font license is what you need. When deciding on a license, we don’t consider the number of times the app is downloaded like many others do. Instead, we focus solely on the number of applications that will use the font.

*You can obtain an App License by choosing the Enterprise package. Contact us to get a quote.

Game

If you’re a game developer, this license gives you the ability to incorporate the font directly into the code of your game. When deciding on a license, we don’t consider the number of times the game is downloaded like many others do. Instead, we focus solely on the number of games that will use the font.

*You can obtain a Game License by choosing the Enterprise package. Contact us to get a quote.

Video & Broadcasting

With this font license, you have the freedom to use the font in various forms of video content, including blogging, YouTube or TV channels, and online or offline broadcasting. The available font license options are based on the extent to which the font will be used in your video content.

*You can obtain a Video & Broadcasting License by choosing the Enterprise package. Contact us to get a quote.

Digital Ads

This font license is perfect for those who need to use the font in banners, digital ads, and posters on the internet, as well as for advertising on social media. The available license options vary based on the number of times the ads featuring the font will be displayed or viewed (ad impressions).

*You can obtain a Digital Ads License in the Freelance or Commercial package, depending on the number of users/devices, company scale, and the quantity needed for products, print, sales, impressions, page views, and images.

e-book

If you’re working on e-books, magazines, interactive PDFs, or other publications, this font license is the right choice for you.

*You can obtain an e-book License in the Freelance or Commercial package, depending on the number of users/devices, company scale, and the quantity needed for products, print, sales, impressions, page views, and images.

Server

This license is designed for unique websites and applications that allow users to create products using the selected font, without the need for an additional font license.

*You can obtain a Server License by choosing the Enterprise package. Contact us to get a quote.

Partnership

This is an invitation for freelancers, marketing agencies, or design studios to partner with Drizy Font. Access is granted to the demo products of Drizy Font, facilitating their creative process and prototyping. If a suitable font is found, an exclusive price will be offered below the standard price displayed on the website.

Subscription / Rental

Gain unlimited access to the complete Drizy Font’s font collection by subscribing to our service. With a subscription, you’ll have access to a wide range of library that can enhance your creative projects.
 
Throughout your subscription period, you can enjoy the benefits of installing all font updates. Rest assured, we regularly update the font collection, ensuring that you have access to the latest and greatest designs.

This gives users the flexibility to choose a font that suits the style or character needed for their project. 

Users need to extend the rental period periodically to obtain a usage license. If the subscription is stopped, all downloaded fonts can still be used but will not have a commercial usage license.

For more information, you can consult with us.

Embed

This is a licensing rental mode for embedding fonts into websites, applications, games, or software for a specific period. During the subscription, companies can use the rented fonts according to the chosen license agreement. Furthermore, companies also receive support from the team in case of any font damage or revision needs. The target audience for this embed font license is well-established multinational companies.

Custom

We offer a flexible approach to customizing standard licenses based on the specific tasks and requirements of your company’s technical department.
 
For example, we can include provisions in the license that allow you to transfer font rights to your contractors during the duration of their work on specific projects. This ensures that the font usage aligns with your company’s needs and facilitates a smooth collaboration with external partners.

Our services include:
Building from scratch — We can create fonts from zero.
Mastering — Realizing your sketches, drafts, lettering, or vectors into professional fonts.
Hinting — Improving the appearance and readability of fonts by making adjustments.
Cyrillization — Implementing Cyrillic characters into fonts

For more information about our services, feel free to talk to us. We are here to help.
